rationale: C206 is a real localized issuer_name parse leak. The raw SOI table separates wrapper categories (Equity Securities, United States, Common Stock/Preferred Stock) from the investment rows, and it also separates Investment, Industry, and Initial Acquisition Date into distinct columns. The stored issuer_name values concatenate those wrapper/term fields into issuer_name, while the cited source rows show the clean issuer names are only Elah Holdings, Inc. and Khoros, LLC (fka Lithium Technologies, Inc.).
